Resolves #18613

Refs #18605

The Neural Link's perspective tools see declared perspectives. `list_perspectives` adds `declared` — the names `activePerspective` accepts, read through `Workspace#declaredPerspectives()` — and `perspective: {active, modified, pending}` read through `PerspectiveState.read`, beside the unchanged saved and topology summaries; the key is the discriminator, since a declared name has no record to summarize. `restore_perspective` looks a name up across the declared list and both record collections, refuses a name found in more than one with the sources named, and routes a declared name through the holder's accepted `activePerspective` write — the path the UI takes, so the carried identity and provenance are identical — re-applying the baseline when the name is already active, since an equal config assignment is a no-op. Under a Group a remote caller is fenced against the live document owners first and an open batch refuses. A holder that declares nothing keeps every existing refusal's shape and outcome (the same keys, `switched: false`, the document untouched); two of its message strings change as well — the no-store refusal now names the missing declaration, and the ambiguity refusal names its sources — and the existing arms stay green on their substrings.

`Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 (as amended by #18606)`.

Evidence: unit tier (a real declaring `Workspace` resolved through the component registry in the single-thread unit runtime; the standalone document-write path spied for the row) → unit tier required for this engine leaf. Residual: none — the Brain half of the wire contract is neomjs/neo-agent-brain#347, which mirrors after this merges; both tool responses are `type: object` without properties and the tool service validates no responses, so the additive fields are wire-safe before the mirror.

## Deltas from ticket
- The discriminator is the key, not a per-row field: `declared: String[]` stands beside the untouched `perspectives` / `topologies` summaries, because a declared name has no record to summarize and a heterogeneous row would reach every consumer of the saved list; `source: 'declared'` marks a declared restore's result instead (the ticket's AC-1 was amended at intake, from @neo-opus-vega's measured matrix).
- The active declared name re-applies its baseline through `resetPerspective()`; the ticket's "takes the `activePerspective` path" is a no-op for an equal assignment, and an agent asking to restore means restore.
- A declaring holder without any store is no longer fail-closed; the refusal fires only when nothing is declared either. The ambiguity message names its sources rather than the fixed "layout and topology collections".
- `DockService.declaredPerspectives(holder)` reads the `Workspace#declaredPerspectives()` facade from #18609 — the same seam the persistence libraries take — which is why this leaf is `blocked_by` #18609 and lands after it.

## Test Evidence
Negative control outside CI: the three arms run against the unchanged `DockService` fail 3 of 3 and pass with the change.
